question: Change the List method on the dynamic.ResourceInterface in k8s.io/client-go/dynamic from returning (*unstructured.UnstructuredList, error) to returning a new paginated result type (PaginatedList, error). The dynamic client is used by tools that need to interact with arbitrary Kubernetes resource types without compile-time type information. Any code calling resClient.List() and expecting *unstructured.UnstructuredList will break.
